1  HON'BLE MANOJ BAJAJ, J.

Applicant has filed this application under Section 447 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Saniha, 2023 seeking transfer of P.S.T. No.511 of 2014, titled State Vs. Rashid, arising out of case crime no.224 of 2014, under Section 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, pending in the court of Special Additional Judge/POCSO Act-III, Firozabad to any other competent court of jurisdiction at District Firozabad.

Learned counsel has argued that the trial court has proceeded with the trial without framing charges against the accused, therefore, he prays that the trial pending before the court of Special Additional Judge/POCSO Act-III, Firozabad be transferred to some other court of competent jurisdiction in the same district.
During the course of hearing, learned counsel for the applicant is repeatedly asked to reveal the ground for transfer, but he continued to emphasis on the merits of the trial.
In the considered opinion of this Court, the merits of the trial would not have any relevance for transfer of the trial.
Concededly, all these grounds were pressed by the applicant before the Sessions Judge, Firozabad and the transfer application was dismissed vide order dated 22.05.2025 being not maintainable.

A perusal of the impugned order would show that the same issues relating to the merits of the case were pressed before the Sessions court, Firozabad and after the rejection of the order, the same issues are being pressed before this Court.
